Our brands in the portfolio like Biryani By Kilo, Costa and Vaango maintained a 7% plus SSSG growth trajectory.
On a consolidated basis, we delivered a 16.5% year -on-year growth in revenues, reaching INR 1,581 crore.
Margins & costs: Our consolidated Operating EBITDA grew nearly 38% year-on-year and represents an EBITDA margin of 9.6%.
Gross Margin improved to 76.3% during the quarter, but higher costs and operating deleverage led to Brand Contribution margin eroding slightly.
However, higher input costs led to lower Gross Margin at 74.6%.
Capex & expansion: BBK continues to progress well on both top line as well as bottom line and we are on track to rea lize the acquisition case turnaround of BBK.

Balance sheet & cash: Effective cost management and operating leverage helped improve the Brand Contribution margin by 1.5% compared to last year and posted Brand Contribution of 18.2% for the quarter.
